name: weixin_split_delivery_units
notes: Delivery-unit split traced end-to-end (fence passthrough, indented continuations, blank-line flushes, unit strings + count hashed). Input encoding: '|' stands for newline. REAL PARITY GAP FOUND (FAP, excluded from walk): the C port never resets nc after a mid-block non-blank flush, so a block with TWO top-level line groups ('hello\nworld') yields LIVE ['hello','world'] but C ['hello','hello\nworld'] — the walk is restricted to blocks with a single top-level group until the port is fixed. Also excluded: whitespace-only lines (LIVE line.strip() blank check vs port rl[0]=='\0').
